verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a first-party Node SDK (@workos-inc/node), including a client-ID-only mode for apps that can't hold secrets. RBAC docs say access is enforced through AuthKit session JWTs, which implies sessions can be verified to protect routes. Nothing documents framework-specific SDKs or route-protecting middleware. Missing for 10: a first-party Next.js SDK, middleware for route protection, edge-runtime session verification, SDKs for peer frameworks, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
